WITH digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN chaninvdatablock::jsonb ->> 'onlineuse' = 'High' 
                 OR chaninvdatablock::jsonb ->> 'mobileuse' = 'High' 
            THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        CEIL(cr.tenureyrs * 4) / 4 AS cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native, 
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size, 
        AVG(cr.churnrate) AS avg_engagement_score, 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.churnrate > 0.7 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage
    FROM 
        core_record cr
    JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter, 
    is_digital_native, 
    cohort_size, 
    avg_engagement_score, 
    high_engagement_percentage
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;

                 OR chaninvdatablock::jsonb ->> 'mobileuse' = 'High' 
            THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        CEIL(cr.tenureyrs * 4) / 4 AS cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native, 
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size, 
        AVG(cr.churnrate) AS avg_engagement_score, 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.churnrate > 0.7 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage
    FROM 
        core_record cr
    JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter, 
    is_digital_native, 
    cohort_size, 
    avg_engagement_score, 
    high_engagement_percentage
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;
